name: hono
title_zh: Hono 路由写一半，它帮你把请求跑通再收工
tagline_zh: 写 Hono 接口时总在猜路由对不对、中间件顺序乱不乱？它直接调起本地服务发真实请求，用 CLI 把响应打给你看。
tagline_en: Tired of guessing if your Hono routes and middleware order work? It boots the app locally, fires real requests.
desc_en: Use when building Hono web applications or when the user asks about Hono APIs, routing, middleware, JSX, validation, testing, or streaming. TRIGGER when code imports from 'hono' or 'hono/*', or user mentions Hono. Use Hono CLI to inspect and test the app.
why_zh: 不是静态查错，是真正把应用跑起来再断言。中间件、JSX、流式响应全在真实运行时里验，比读文档快。
why_en: It doesn't lint your code—it boots the app and asserts against live responses. Middleware, JSX, streaming all get verified in.
limit_zh: 只认 Hono 应用，且本机需能正常启动 Node/Deno 服务；不覆盖部署、数据库迁移或第三方 API 联调。
limit_en: Hono-only; requires a locally bootable Node/Deno server. No deployment, DB migration, or third-party API integration. Stops at verifying request.
title_en: Hono router half-written? It runs the request before you.
